sourceHierarchy.rule: A FactSet value may fill a historical Codex blank only when it is an actual quarter-specific value, internally consistent, and not an estimate, error, placeholder, or ambiguous zero. Existing Codex values are never overwritten.

acceptedFallbacks.note: Accepted because the FactSet CRK worksheet provides a continuous historical quarterly FCF row alongside operating cash flow and capital expenditures. The values are maintained in the normalized FCF registry and remain subordinate to any future filing-verified Codex series.

rejectedFallbacks.factSetObservation: The historical NGL production row is an unbroken series of 0 or #N/A values.
rejectedFallbacks.reason: Ambiguous zero series cannot be distinguished from unavailable or non-disclosed data. Project rules prohibit treating missing historical data as zero.
rejectedFallbacks.result: Remain null in the Codex historical dataset.

rejectedFallbacks.factSetObservation: The historical realized NGL price row is an unbroken series of 0 values.
rejectedFallbacks.reason: A continuous zero price is not economically credible as a verified realized-price series and is treated as unavailable rather than reported zero.
rejectedFallbacks.result: Remain null in the Codex historical dataset.

rejectedFallbacks.factSetObservation: No wells-drilled row exists in the CRK FactSet worksheet.
rejectedFallbacks.result: Retain Codex filing-derived values where present; do not create additional values.

rejectedFallbacks.factSetObservation: No TIL / wells-turned-in-line row exists in the CRK FactSet worksheet.
rejectedFallbacks.result: Retain Codex filing-derived values where present; do not create additional values.

rejectedFallbacks.factSetObservation: No DUC inventory row exists in the CRK FactSet worksheet.
rejectedFallbacks.result: Remain null unless a company filing or supplemental disclosure provides a comparable quarter-end well count.

rejectedFallbacks.factSetObservation: No comparable historical unit-cost rows exist in the CRK FactSet worksheet.
rejectedFallbacks.reason: No fallback metric is available; existing Codex values remain controlling.
